items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: That's right. Yeah. Yeah, Sonny Clapper. I used to laugh at his name.

ctx.x: That was a white trombone player. Yeah. That's right. Yeah. Yeah, Sonny Clapper. I used to laugh at his name.
